subject: Demo recording + slides — quick 15-min Q&A?
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@atlasanalytics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Atlas demo — recording + slides

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really enjoyed learning more about Atlas Analytics' ingestion pipeline and the high-throughput embedding use case you described. As promised, attaching the recording and the slide deck for you and the team to review.

Attachments:
- atlas-demo-recording.mp4 (recording, 28m)
- atlas-presentation-slides.pdf

Quick summary of the next recommended steps based on our discussion:
- Evaluate cost/latency tradeoffs for your 2 use cases (search + personalization) — we can share a cost estimate with RL throughput assumptions
- Short POC to validate end-to-end throughput with your current data flow (2–4 week runway)
- Security and compliance checklist: we sent the SOC 2 evidence link to procurement in our earlier thread (copy below).

Would you be open to a short 15–20 minute Q&A with Vivek (SE) later this week to run through the recording and answer any technical questions? A few slots that work for us: Thu 11/19 10:00–10:20 PT, Thu 11/19 15:00–15:20 PT, Fri 11/20 09:00–09:20 PT. If none of those work, let me know a preferred time.

If now isn't the right priority, totally understand — a quick note on timing would help us plan next steps.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

--- Original meeting notes excerpt ---
[10:15] Use cases: interactive search (low latency) + nightly bulk embeddings (throughput)
[10:30] Security: needs SOC 2 + contract visibility for data residency (US only)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@atlasanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Atlas demo — recording + slides

Thanks Marissa — really helpful summary and the recording is great.

Quick question for Vivek: on the POC, will Redwood be able to support 3x concurrent ingestion workers with a steady-state of 50 qps for embedding calls? Also curious what the expected unit cost would be for 25M monthly embedding tokens.

Can we do Thu 11/19 15:00 PT for the 15-min Q&A? That works for me. I'll see if Omar can join as well.

Thanks —
Samantha
Director, Product — Atlas Analytics
